attacks.claim: The duplicate-ballot log writes the voter's email together with the attempted choice on every rejected second ballot. Logs ship to a third-party host readable by the whole support team, so a resident's vote becomes linkable to their identity outside the tally, which breaks the core anonymity promise. Once shipped, that exposure cannot be recalled.
